text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
with Special Week—
(Ding-dooong!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaann! Are you in there~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Pardon the intrusion~!
choice_data_list: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Umm... well, you see.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, do you remember? About what I 
had you hold onto for me."

Speaking of what I was holding onto for 
Special Week――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Right now doesn't really feel like the 
time to relax at a hot spring... There are 
just so many things I need to work hard 
on."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Once you finish everything properly, I'll 
give it back to you then!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Did you remember?
choice_data_list: Hot spring trip tickets won in the raffle?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! —So, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I've had someone in mind 
that I wanted to go with ever since then.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I've achieved results I can 
truly be proud of— I can finally say it!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's go to the hot springs 
together!
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *yaaaawn*~... That felt so good~...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Trainer, you're acting kind of like 
an old grandpa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Trainer, you're acting kind of like 
an old grandma.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... Oh, right!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"There's still some time before dinner... 
Would it be alright if I hung out in your 
room, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, it feels kind of magical, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even though this isn't a training camp, 
nor is it for an upcoming race—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Staying the night like this, with you, 
Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... Oh, right!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
During the camp, and before and after 
races, all you ever talked about was me, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Things like the training menu, physical 
condition... and of course, mental care as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Except today, that's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, I want to hear 
lots and lots of stories from you tonight, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've had you listen to so many things 
about my family, my friends, my worries, 
and my dreams, after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I—want to know all about you too, Trainer!

...After that, the two of us talked 
leisurely until Special Week's stomach 
began to growl.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Special Week...
